AlertComponent.name: AlertComponent
AlertComponent.description:
A colored message box. The content is projected, for example
`<lab900-alert [type]="Alert.Warn">Unsaved changes</lab900-alert>`.

members.description: Sets the color and the meaning of the alert

Alert.name: Alert
Alert.description: The types of `lab900-alert`. Expose the enum on your component to bind it, for example `[type]="Alert.Error"`.

NavItem.name: NavItem
NavItem.description:
One entry of a nav list: a route, an external link, or a parent of nested items.
An item without a route, a link or visible children is not shown.

members.name: label
members.description: A translation key

members.name: route
members.description: The router link of the item

members.name: routeQueryParams
members.description: The query params of the route

members.name: href
members.description: An external link instead of a route

members.name: children
members.description: Nested items. A click on the parent expands them; the parent of the active route starts expanded.

members.name: childrenInOverlay
members.description: Show the children in an overlay instead of below the item, on screens wider than `allowOverlayMenuUntil` of the list

members.name: navigationFinished
members.description: Called after the navigation to the route of the item has finished, for example to close a sidenav

members.name: routeMatchOptions
members.description: When the item is active. Overrides the `routeMatchOptions` of the list.

members.name: uniqueId
members.description: Will be automatically generated

NavItemGroup.name: NavItemGroup
NavItemGroup.description: A group of nav items with an optional heading. A group without visible items is not shown.

members.name: label

members.name: icon
members.description: An icon next to the heading

members.name: uniqueId
members.description: Will be automatically generated

members.name: name
members.description: A Material icon name

members.name: svgName

members.name: position

Lab900NavListComponent.name: Lab900NavListComponent
Lab900NavListComponent.description: A navigation menu of grouped items, with nested levels. Hidden items and empty groups are left out.

members.name: allowOverlayMenuUntil

Media queries, for example the CDK `Breakpoints`, where items with `childrenInOverlay` expand below the item

Lab900MergerComponent.name: Lab900MergerComponent
Lab900MergerComponent.description:
Compares two objects side by side, one row per schema config, and lets the user pick values from the other side.
Rows with a difference get an arrow; a click on it merges that value.

members.name: fixed
members.description: Keep `selectedSide`: the user cannot switch the side that the merge starts from

members.name: loading
members.description: Show a progress bar instead of the rows

members.name: schema
members.description: One row per config. The order of the configs is the order of the rows.

members.name: selectedSide
members.description: The side that the merge starts from. The active values of the other side are merged into it.

members.name: schemaChange
members.description: Emits the schema with the choices of the user: `active` is set on the configs that are merged

members.name: resultChange
members.description: Emits the merged object after every change

Lab900MergerItemComponent.name: Lab900MergerItemComponent
Lab900MergerItemComponent.description: One side of a merger row. The merger renders it; you only need it to build your own merger layout.

members.name: data
members.description: The whole object of this side

members.name: active
members.description: Highlight the item as the side that the merge starts from

members.name: data
members.description: The object to compare

members.name: title
members.description: The heading above this side

MergeConfigBase.name: MergeConfigBase
MergeConfigBase.description: A property to show. It is also the type of the fields in `nestedObject`.

members.name: attribute
members.description: The property of the object

members.name: label
members.description: A translation key, shown next to the value

members.name: formatter
members.description: Turns the value into the text of the row. It can return an observable.

members.name: rowClass
members.description: CSS classes on the row

members.name: nextLine
members.description: Show the value below the label instead of next to it

members.name: active
members.description: Merge the value of the other side. The user sets it with the arrow of the row; set it to start merged.

members.name: component
members.description: A component that shows the row instead of the label and value. It receives the whole object as `data`.

members.name: nestedObject
members.description:
Fields shown together in one row and merged together. With an `attribute` the fields are properties of that
object property, and the whole object is merged. Without it they are top-level properties.

members.name: combine
members.description: Merge an array property by joining both arrays instead of replacing one

members.name: disabled
members.description: The user cannot change `active`, and a reset keeps it

MergerItemComponent.name: MergerItemComponent
MergerItemComponent.description:
Contract for a custom component that shows the value of a merge config.
The merger sets the data with setInput, so a signal input and a decorator input are both possible.

members.name: data
members.description: The whole object of the side that the component is on

Lab900ButtonComponent.name: Lab900ButtonComponent
Lab900ButtonComponent.description:
A Material button of any type, with icons and a translated label. Clicks are throttled, so a double click
emits `btnClick` once.

members.name: type
members.description: The Material button variant. Without a type it is a text button.

members.name: suffixIcon
members.description: Material icon name after the label. Not shown on the icon and fab types.

members.name: prefixIcon
members.description: Material icon name before the label. Not shown on the icon and fab types.

members.name: label
members.description: A translation key. For the icon and fab types it is the icon name instead.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description:
A translation key for the accessible name of the button. Set it on the icon and fab types: without it, a screen
reader reads the icon name.

members.name: svgIcon
members.description: Read the icon names as names of icons registered in the `MatIconRegistry`, not as Material icon names.

members.name: buttonType
members.description: The `type` attribute of the `<button>` element. Use `submit` to submit a form.

members.name: containerClass
members.description: CSS classes on the `<button>` element

members.name: buttonId
members.description: The `id` of the `<button>` element

members.name: throttleTimeInMs
members.description: Clicks within this time after the previous click are ignored

members.name: btnClick
members.description: Emits on a click, at most once per `throttleTimeInMs`

Lab900ActionButtonComponent.description:

ActionButtonEvent.description: What the `action` function of an ActionButton receives

members.name: event

members.name: data

ActionButton.name: ActionButton
ActionButton.description:
The config of a `lab900-action-button`. The page header and the table take lists of them.
`T` is the type of the data that the function options receive.

members.name: label
members.description: A translation key. For the icon and fab types it is the icon name instead.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description:
A translation key for the accessible name of the button. The icon and fab types fall back to the tooltip, then to
the icon name, so set it on an icon button without a tooltip.

members.name: action
members.description: Runs on a click. Not called when the button has sub actions: the button then opens them.

members.name: type
members.description: The Material button variant, or `toggle` for a button toggle group of the sub actions. Without a type it is a text button.

members.name: selected
members.description: On a sub action of a toggle: the option that is selected

members.name: subActions
members.description: Actions in a menu that the button opens. With the `toggle` type they are the options of the toggle group.

members.name: tooltip
members.description: A tooltip with a translation key. The position is `above` by default.

members.name: suffixIcon
members.description: Material icon name after the label

members.name: prefixIcon
members.description: Material icon name before the label

members.name: svgIcon
members.description: Read the icon names as names of icons registered in the `MatIconRegistry`

members.name: containerClass
members.description: CSS classes on the `<button>` element

members.name: buttonId
members.description: The `id` of the `<button>` element

members.name: align
members.description: In the page header: the side of the header that the button is on

members.name: hideSelectionIndicator
members.description: On a toggle: hide the check mark of the selected option

members.name: keepMenuOpen
members.description: On a sub action in a menu: keep the menu open after a click

Lab900ButtonType.name: Lab900ButtonType
Lab900ButtonType.description: The Material button variants. `icon`, `fab` and `mini-fab` show only an icon.

PreventDoubleClickDirective.name: PreventDoubleClickDirective
PreventDoubleClickDirective.description: Ignores the clicks that follow a click within `throttleTimeInMs`. Listen to `throttledClick` instead of `click`.

members.name: throttleTimeInMs
members.description: Clicks within this time after the previous click are ignored

members.name: throttledClick
members.description: Emits on a click, at most once per `throttleTimeInMs`
